# DarcyIQ

> DarcyIQ is an agentic AI platform for professional services companies that automates the client lifecycle from pipeline to delivery. Built by Innovative Solutions, an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner, DarcyIQ helps consulting firms, MSPs, and services companies automate proposals, scope projects, manage client engagements, and accelerate AWS partner workflows using AI agents that understand your business.

## Core Platform

- [DarcyIQ Homepage](https://darcyiq.com/): Agentic AI platform for services companies, consulting firms, and MSPs — automates the full client lifecycle from first conversation to delivered project
- [Agentic Delivery](https://darcyiq.com/agentic): Captures pre-sales promises and pipes structured context into developer tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and Windsurf
- [MCP Studio](https://darcyiq.com/mcp): Connect any data source to your AI agents using Model Context Protocol, with 50+ ready-to-use connectors or build custom integrations in minutes
- [Pricing](https://darcyiq.com/pricing): Simple pricing plans for the agentic AI platform, scaled for teams and enterprises

## Features

- [Agentic Chat](https://darcyiq.com/features/chat): AI assistant powered by DarcyOS with its own server for complex task execution, not just conversation
- [AI Agents](https://darcyiq.com/features/agents): Deploy hundreds of customizable autonomous agents on schedules or triggers, built for consulting firms and MSPs
- [AI Meeting Assistant](https://darcyiq.com/features/meetings): Joins client calls in real-time, surfaces suggested responses, and captures every requirement automatically
- [AI SOW Generator](https://darcyiq.com/features/scoping): Self-learning AI agent that understands your services, solutions, and pricing to automate proposal scoping
- [AWS Partner Sales Automation](https://darcyiq.com/features/awsace): Automates ACE and WAFR workflows, identifies POs, and completes submissions in under a minute
- [Integrations](https://darcyiq.com/features/integrations): 50+ out-of-the-box connectors including Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Slack, and AWS, plus MCP Studio for custom connectors
- [Projects](https://darcyiq.com/features/projects): AI-powered client engagement workspace with proposals, meetings, documents, and decisions in one searchable place
- [Blueprints](https://darcyiq.com/features/blueprints): Upload any document template and AI auto-detects fields and fills them from meeting context and scoped requirements
- [AI Lead Enrichment](https://darcyiq.com/features/leadlists): Bulk lead research, qualification, and call script generation using AI agents
